The reference's gfx942 LDS-fit heuristic drops to the small BLOCK_KV=128 tile for the 32768-long KV stream and under-occupies the CU; the win scales with the KV tile (largest at M2048/4096 ~4.2x).

approaches.summary: Drive the reference's OWN aiter _fp8_mqa_logits_kernel with BLOCK_KV=256, num_stages=1 on gfx942 (float8_e4m3fnuz recast with matched scale compensation), but ONLY when the reference's _gfx942_tile_fits_lds heuristic would have dropped to the small BLOCK_KV=128 tile; otherwise defer to the untouched reference. Launch/tiling config only -- BLOCK_SIZE_K and the MQA math are untouched. Landed as the committed AMD candidate and re-gated from committed bytes.
approaches.why: The heuristic under-tiles the 32768-long KV stream on gfx942; forcing the larger KV tile amortizes per-tile setup and lifts occupancy. Because only the KV tiling/stage count changes (never the fp8 accumulation width) calc_diff stays 0.0. The win is largest where the small-tile heuristic bit hardest (M2048/4096 ~4.2x).

lesson: For fp8 MQA-logits (index_score) prefill on gfx942, the aiter reference's LDS-fit heuristic picks a too-small BLOCK_KV for the 32k KV stream. A bit-exact candidate that re-launches the reference's OWN _fp8_mqa_logits_kernel with BLOCK_KV=256 / num_stages=1 -- guarded to fire only when the heuristic would have dropped to the small tile -- wins 1.44x / 4.17x / 4.19x at M=1024/2048/4096 (geo 2.93x) with worst_calc_diff 0.0. Never touch BLOCK_SIZE_K; on AMD recast Q/KV to float8_e4m3fnuz with matched x2 scale compensation to stay bit-exact.
